notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Tweaked the headset detection when the game is paused. The game will now automatically unpause when the headset is on.

Overall polish. Text placement is slightly changed. 

Added V sync option.

notes.title: Update V 1.04
notes.content:
-Added a "grabber" so players can pick up items that fall on the floor more easily..
-Items will snap to your hand when you use the grabber
-Game will pause now when the headset is taken off or the dash is open.
